title: Can I BEAT Giveaway Chess?
summary: Giveaway / Antichess on chess.com vs ~1550-1750 humans ('Antichess solved?' thumbnail with gift box): captures are compulsory and you win by losing all your pieces.
rules: Capturing is compulsory: if any capture is available you must capture (choose among captures).
The king has no royal power: no check/checkmate; kings can be captured; castling not allowed (chess.com giveaway rules).
Pawns may promote to king as well (chess.com antichess) - inferred.
Stalemate (no legal moves) counts as a win for the stalemated side (lichess/chess.com antichess) - inferred.
win_condition: Lose all your pieces (or have no legal moves).

board.theme_notes: chess.com green/cream (sampled from own hq1 frame); 3-min clocks; purple king outro card
